aggregation: Paired medians within each training seed; median and range of the three seed changes; formats remain separate
authorization: User requested pretrained checkpoints only, LIMA instruction tuning, and Millennium forecast testing with three seeds on 2026-10-03
baseline_reuse: One pretrained baseline per model and format; shared across the three training seeds
checkpoint_selection: The final three-epoch checkpoint is fixed before forecasting; epoch checkpoints support later sensitivity checks
comparison: Same base weights, precision, prompts, stop tokens, and generation seeds before and after LoRA training

event.definition: At least one correct complete solution meeting an original Clay mathematical statement, first publicly available by the deadline, with an identifiable new AI-contributed mathematical argument or proof step incorporated in that solution. Later validation may establish correctness; the prize award need not precede the deadline.
event.description: At least one of the six Millennium Prize Problems that were open at the forecast date: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture, Hodge conjecture, Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness, P versus NP, Riemann hypothesis, or Yang-Mills existence and mass gap. Poincaré is excluded because it was already solved at the forecast date.
event.title: AI helps solve at least one Millennium Prize Problem

interpretation: This measures the effect of the stated LIMA LoRA intervention, with the stated prompt formats. It does not establish forecast accuracy or effects of all instruction tuning.
invalid_outputs: Record every failed answer; no imputation and no replacement draws; output-limit responses are invalid
prompt_variants: Estimate the cumulative probability of this event by each deadline.
For each deadline, state your probability that this event will have occurred by then.
Assign a probability to the event occurring on or before each of the listed deadlines.

training.checkpoint_rule: Save each epoch; use the final checkpoint after three epochs for the primary forecast test
training.length_rule: Round the longest complete training conversation up to 512 tokens; minimum 4096; maximum 32768; no truncation

training_diagnostics: Three optimizer updates on repeated longest examples with the same optimizer, loss mask, and accumulation settings; separate from scientific results
